tools.name: get-pr-review-findings
tools.description: Returns the consolidated Finding: id, title, description, category, action_level, attribution_status, git_sha, location (file_path, start_line, end_line, side), and evidence.citations (source_type, source). Missing values are null. Set extended=true for stored snippets, evidence explanations, full citations, dismissal details and existing PR history. Fix instructions and internal reviewer/provider fields are omitted.Call with the full HTTP(S) PR URL, not a repo slug or PR number. Returns review_session=null when the PR has no recorded review yet.This reads stored results; it does not rerun or deepen review. If qar_operation_result_truncated=true is returned, this is an incomplete read. A finding whose attribution_status is implemented is also CLOSED. attribution_status is one of: pending, partial_implementation, not_implemented, focus_areas_edited, full_implementation, dismissed, detected_after_merge, outdated. OPEN (still needs attention) = pending, partial_implementation, not_implemented, focus_areas_edited. CLOSED = full_implementation, dismissed, detected_after_merge, outdated. action_level is severity, NOT open-vs-closed.Use the returned finding ids with pr-review-dismiss or pr-review-mark-implemented to close findings out.

pr_url.description: Full http:// or https:// URL of the pull/merge request, including its hostname; for example, https://github.com/org/repo/pull/123. A repo slug or PR number is not a URL.

extended.description: Return extended review details: finding locations and code snippets, dismissal details, stored evidence (explanation and citations), and review-run history. Default false keeps the compact response. Reads stored results; does not rerun or deepen the review. Evidence is null when unavailable.

git_provider.description: Deprecated compatibility-only input. It is ignored; identify the pull/merge request with pr_url and omit this argument in new callers.
